newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Surgical to acquire Orion.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Surgical to acquire Orion.

text.p: Sparta Surgical Corp on Tuesday signed a non-binding letter of intent for the acquisition of substantially all of the operating assets of Orion Life Systems Inc and its wholly owned subsidiary, Orion Medical Products Inc.

In a statement the company said the purchase price will be about $3 million consisting of $450,000 in cash, $100,000 in notes payable over five years, $550,000 in royalty equal to 1.5% of net sales, the assumption of approximately $1,100,000 in bank debt and the remaining $800,000 in the form of an assumption of other liabilities.

The letter of intent also calls for Sparta to issue earn-out common shares to Orion's president subject to Orion meeting certain net sales and pre-tax profit goals beginning the fiscal year ending February 28, 1998. The transaction is expected to be completed by the end of December 1996.
